text:
maria (AE): Scout AI wants a perf POC next Tues — goal: steady 1k QPS, microbursts to 3k for 30s, p95 <200ms. They need a load plan, runbook, pricing estimate (hosted + dedicated), and security questionnaire answers (KMS/HSM + audit logs). Can we scope?

oliver (SE): Ack. Which model and avg token lengths?

maria (AE): Conversational assistant. avg prompt ~120 tokens, response ~150 tokens. They prefer redwood-7b (int8) but open to cheaper variants.

kevin (eng): Suggested plan: 10m ramp to 1k, steady 30-60m, 3 microbursts (30s @3k) spaced every 10-15m. KV cache warmup required. Queue sizing: concurrency ~= QPS * latency. For 200ms p95 => 200 concurrent; add headroom -> aim 400 concurrency. Autoscale target <250ms tail.

kevin (eng): Wrk commands to emulate: 
```bash
# steady 1k qps for 30m
wrk -t8 -c400 -d30m -R1000 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua
# microburst 30s @ 3k qps
wrk -t8 -c1200 -d30s -R3000 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua
```

oliver (SE): Baseline config: batch_size=32, kv_cache=enabled, quantization=int8, pinned model: redwood-7b-q8. Sample payload: {"model":"redwood-7b-q8","input_tokens":120,"max_tokens":160,"temperature":0.0}

li (sre): We'll enable tracing + per-token metrics. Region: us-west-2. If they want HSM-backed keys we need Private deployment; hosted/dedicated support customer-managed KMS but not HSM. Multi-AZ failover during run?

nina (sec): Security: encryption at rest AES-256, KMS integration yes (CMK allowed), HSM only in Private. Audit logs available; I'll prepare redacted example. Need their data retention requirements. We'll send security questionnaire before run.

maria (AE): Pricing: need hosted estimate for steady+bursts and a monthly dedicated reserved estimate with burst allowance.

oliver (SE): Quick token calc: ~270 tokens/request -> 270k tokens/sec at 1k qps. I'll put an hourly token burn figure. Dedicated rough: 6-10 A100-equiv GPUs depending on concurrency and optimizations. I'll draft pricing note and CSV template for run results.

perf-bot: scheduled job created: scoutai_poc/1747512345/run1 @ 2024-11-19T18:00Z

maria (AE): Proposed window: Tue 18:00 UTC, 2 hours. @kevin (eng) @oliver (SE) own smoke + steady run? @nina (sec) can you get sec Q done by EOD tomorrow?

kevin (eng): I'll own smoke/warmup, will push wrk scripts and a realistic `llm_post.lua`. Adding GPU util monitor and a script to auto-fallback if GPU >80%.

oliver (SE): I'll write the runbook (steps, failure modes, rollback), include fallback policy: model_chain = [redwood-7b-q8, redwood-3b-q4, redwood-1.3b-q4] and add guidance on burst triggers.

nina (sec): I'll prepare KMS note, SOC2 snippet, and redacted audit logs. Legal will weigh in if they insist on HSM.

maria (AE): Great. I'll brief Scout AI and confirm Tue. Will attach questionnaire when they return it.
